goals: Blue/white/light-grey base suited to technical geospatial application
Clear separation between observed, estimated and unverified property/building facts
Do not use a building's estimated facade colour to imply ownership, quality or safety

typography.fontStack: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

uiComponents.topBar: white/light panel with primary-blue actions; sticky at desktop, compact on small screen
uiComponents.mapCanvas: dominant canvas; panels should not cover selected feature or navigation controls
uiComponents.leftSearchPanel: search and quick filters, avoid more than two levels of nesting
uiComponents.buildingDetailsPanel: location/source first, dimensional estimates next, imagery references and 3D confidence clearly separated
uiComponents.imageryGallery: each source shows author/source, licence, capture date, location precision and confidence; no unlabeled copyrighted media
uiComponents.confidenceBadge: text label + icon, not color alone
uiComponents.colorSwatches: always display hex and mark sampled vs estimated
uiComponents.loadingState: skeleton or small spinner; preserve map interaction where possible
uiComponents.errors: human-readable error and retry action; do not rely on red alone

rules: Text/icon contrast target 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text/UI boundaries; run automated contrast checks before implementation.
Colour is never the only signal for selected, verified, warning or error state.
Use visible keyboard focus and accessible labels for map controls.
Ensure labels, attribution and image licence are legible on both light and dark panels.
accessibility.note: Tokens are a proposed palette; automated contrast and actual component-state testing are still required before claiming WCAG conformance.

evidencePolicy.palette: Every hex value attached to a photo/project is an estimated design colour unless pixel extraction and image provenance are explicitly recorded. It is not a measured paint/manufacturer colour.
evidencePolicy.location: Keep locationText, coordinates if provided, location source, precision level, and building-match confidence separately. A photo GPS point can be a camera location, not the photographed building centroid.
evidencePolicy.projectInfo: Architect/developer pages describe design intent/project programme; distinguish these from independent survey, current as-built verification, property availability and official cadastral data.
evidencePolicy.copyright: Source accessibility does not imply reuse permission. CC BY and CC BY-SA media require the particular licence's attribution/ShareAlike terms; editorial, property-listing, developer and architecture-site media remain research-only unless permission is clear.
evidencePolicy.reconstruction: Preserve source footprint, imagery reference, inferred facade parameters and output mesh as linked but separate records. Low-confidence inference must not overwrite source geometry.
